roadmap.title: I attempt to cast a simple dark scrying spell at four years old, but my mana backlashes, leaving me with a nosebleed and a week-long fever. The court assumes I’m just "delicate."
beats:
### Chapter 3: family_interaction_misunderstanding
I draw a precise summoning circle with crayons, hoping to call a demonic gnat.
My mother finds it, tears up at the "family portrait" inside, and frames it.

roadmap.title: I manipulate the nursery maids into giving me extra dessert by saying, "Father says I’m his brave little soldier." It works. I hate that it works.
beats:
### Chapter 5:
My first tutor quits after I correct his spell formula mid-lesson.
The court assumes I’m a prodigy.
I am, but not in the way they think.

roadmap.title: I attempt to "garden" a mana-siphoning crystal array in the royal gardens. My father proudly shows it off as "Lily’s pretty rock garden" at a diplomatic summit.
beats:
### Chapter 7: first_scheme_attempt
I try to intimidate Prince Leo with a faint hex, but it feels like a tickle.
He thinks I’m flirting and challenges me to an arm-wrestling match.

roadmap.title: Eris arrives to tutor me in magic. I correct her on a "lost" theorem, and she becomes my sobbing, obsessive fan. I exploit this to get forbidden grimoires.
beats:
### Chapter 10:
Zephyr visits and notices my dolls arranged in military formations.
I feed his spies false leads about a "Crumble Conspiracy."

roadmap.title: The "Crumble Conspiracy" report is presented to my father. He laughs for an hour. Zephyr’s reputation is ruined. I send him a thank-you fruit basket.
beats:
### Chapter 12: emotional_conflict_hint
I overhear my parents arguing about my "fragility." My mother suggests I might be "too advanced" for my age.

roadmap.title: Baphomutt the imp starts haunting the castle, leaving stolen jewels in my room. I try to get rid of him, but he’s too loyal (and too stupid) to leave.
beats:
### Chapter 14:
My parents find the jewels.
I improvise a story about "finding them for the poor." They declare me a charitable prodigy and hold a festival in my honor.
